set.body:
Outcome

Atomically remove the locus-data artifact after all compatibility consumers have migrated.

Work

- Assign algebra-only modules to locus4s-core and Field/aggregation consumers to locus4s-data.
- Keep grid-domain adoption on the separate image4s-locus/VolumeDomain track.
- Delete the package facade, MapEvidence, duplicated Parcellation/Searchlight/Aggregation/DomainFactory code, obsolete errors, and alias-only tests.
- Remove the project, aggregates, aliases, Cats-only dependency edges, and stale module references from build.sbt, README, module maps, and plans.
- Mark docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md historical or superseded rather than leaving it as current architecture.
- Check for transitive consumers that previously received locus-data accidentally.

Acceptance

- build.sbt contains no locusData project or dependsOn edge.
- No source or documentation presents scalafim-locus-data as a current artifact.
- Each consumer declares only the smallest authoritative upstream artifact.
- No accidental transitive dependency is required for compilation.
- The deletion contains no voxel-order reinterpretation and no unrelated module cleanup.
set.title: Rewire consumers and delete the scalafim-locus-data artifact
